# Vendored third-party files

Not authored here: copied unchanged from npm (via jsDelivr). Update by replacing the files and the versions below.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `basecoat.cdn.min.css`, `basecoat-all.min.js` | [basecoat-css](https://basecoatui.com) (shadcn/ui as plain HTML classes) | 1.3.0 | MIT ([BASECOAT-LICENSE](BASECOAT-LICENSE)) |
| `htmx.min.js` | [htmx.org](https://htmx.org) | 2.0.11 | 0BSD ([HTMX-LICENSE](HTMX-LICENSE)) |

Basecoat's script watches the page for new elements (a MutationObserver), so components inside htmx-swapped content start by themselves.
